entries.land_description: Several lots for sale - price range $12,000-17,000 for 100' on the lake. ... woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women

entries.notes: I offer a very reasonable (under $20 per night) Bed and Breakfast in Kansas City. Guests have private room and bath, use of living room, den, dining room and kitchen. Breakfast is made to order. Smoking permitted. No credit cards. A $5 deposit required on all reservations.

Lowell House offers a unique Denver experience for women travelers. It is a lesbian-owned, smoke-free Bed & Breakfast Inn designed by a woman for women. Two cozy bedrooms are named after women's movies and decorated appropriately. A central bathroom is shared by the guests. Close to women's entertainment spots, downtown Denver, and several parks, Lowell House is a perfect place for Denver visitors.

entries.welcomed_groups: girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, gay males, chemically sensitive
entries.notes: Bed and full breakfast in the mile-high city of Prescott, AZ (cool in summer), a town of 25,000 with sparkling clean air two hours from Phoenix. I offer sauna, horseshoes, delicious lunches and dinners (extra), hikes with lunch provided ($15), and trips to Sedina and Flagstaff (extra). $40 double and $20 single. 50% work exchange available. Pick-up in Phoenix, $25 each, if not busy. No smoking, perfumes, scents, Downey. . Possibly safe for the chemically sensitive.

The Langtry is an elegant restored 1894 Victorian which is operated as first-class accommodations for the woman traveler. We have five bedrooms, two with private bath, a hot tub, and tennis courts nearby. We are about 20 minutes walking distance from San Francisco's Gay District (the Castro) and a half mile from City Hall. Our rates range from $75 to $200 per night, which include a gourmet breakfast and airport pickup.

entries.land_description: our back garden, under mature redwoods and eucalyptus, beside soft-talking Strawberry Creek
entries.notes: Luci & Justina. We have one charming guest room on the second floor with sloping ceilings and skylights. A shared bathroom with tub and shower is on the main floor, but most guests prefer the hot tub on the deck. Though we're only a few blocks from downtown, has an air of solitude and relaxation. $45 per night, single or double occupancy, with continental breakfast.

entries.community_name: EL MAR VISTA B & B FOR WOMEN ONLY
entries.notes: El Mar Vista is a private home with two bedrooms, bath and small living room on the second floor, which is used exclusively for guests. We are located inside a private gate on five acres overlooking Monterey Bay. There is a hot tub available. Soquel is about 15 miles south of Santa Cruz and 45 miles north of Monterey and Carmel, so there are many interesting tourist facilities.

entries.land_description: located on Mendocino Coast. Charming and secluded cottage in the Redwoods. Wood stove ... Four state parks with hiking trails, horseback riding on beach, and abalone diving in season. River canoeing, ocean & freshwater fishing, and tidepools. Wimmin-owned hot tubs/sauna, restaurants and shopping. Dramatic coastline, Albion wimmin, and no offshore oil drilling.
entries.notes: breakfast in bed, 10 minutes to the coast.

entries.land_description: located at 10573 E Hwy 20. On the shore of Clear Lake
entries.notes: Blue Fish Cove is the perfect place for relaxing, unwinding, and enjoying the company of that special person. Activities include picnicking, boating, swimming and fishing. Owners Marge and Dona offer beach cottages, boat launching, boat rentals, TV and air conditioning. Six units have fully-equipped kitchens, a game room with pool table and workshop capability is also available. Open all year. We are wheel-chair accessible.

entries.land_description: wilderness, private non-commercial naturalist place. Hike in 1 mile. ... no plumbing, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land, art and music.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: c/o Sarah Bird, Youth Hostel style Guest House (bring sleeping bags) open spring/summer. Arrive Friday nights for women's coffeehouse. Fireplace lodge overnights $3/day. Tenting, river swimming, hiking, mountain biking, horses ok. Travel light or by bicycle. No parking for cars unless by prior arrangements. Park in Covelo, Dial-a-Ride and ask for Women's Youth Hostel. Women artists and musicians wanted. A beautiful peaceful river retreat in the Yolla Bolly Wilderness.
